data.narrative:
Deep Sentinel, a Series B-stage defense and security company, has raised $55M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 comparables—two public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private-stage peers in Defense & Security, including Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method, using total raised as a proxy baseline, applied a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $104M. The peer-median approach across eight same-sector, same-stage comparables produced a median valuation of $1.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The peer distribution reflects substantial dispersion within the sector at this stage.

The triangulated analysis yields a valuation range of $89M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $615M. This wide band reflects the methodology divergence: stage-progression anchors conservatively to capital deployed, while peer-median captures market multiples for later-stage players. Key uncertainties include Deep Sentinel's product maturity, revenue traction, and market positioning relative to the identified peer set. Resolution of these factors would narrow the range meaningfully.
